import json, random, sys, time, importlib.util
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import ref
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("main", "/workspace/submission/main.py")
main = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(main)
rng=random.Random(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 0)
NC=6
rib=[]
for s in range(NC):
    rib.append({'path':[((s+k)%NC)+1 for k in range(NC)],'count':rng.randint(1,1000000)})
CHAIN=[10000+i for i in range(64)]
while len(rib)<2000 and sum(len(r['path']) for r in rib)+18<=40000:
    s0=rng.randrange(0,64-18); L=rng.randint(3,18)
    p=CHAIN[s0:s0+L]
    if rng.random()<0.3: p=p[::-1]
    if rng.random()<0.2: p=[rng.choice([900001,900002])]+p
    rib.append({'path':p,'count':rng.randint(1,1000000)})
order=[]
for s in range(NC):
    a=(s%NC)+1; b=((s+1)%NC)+1
    order.append([min(a,b),max(a,b)])
priors=[]; seen=set()
while len(priors)<2000:
    a=rng.randint(1,120000); b=rng.randint(1,120000)
    if a==b: continue
    e=(min(a,b),max(a,b))
    if e in seen: continue
    seen.add(e)
    w=[rng.randint(0,1000000) for _ in range(3)]
    if sum(w)==0: w[0]=1
    priors.append({'link':list(e),'weights':w})
declared=[]; sd=set()
while len(declared)<2000:
    a=rng.randint(1,120000); b=rng.randint(1,120000)
    if a==b: continue
    e=(min(a,b),max(a,b))
    if e in sd: continue
    sd.add(e)
    declared.append({'link':list(e),'rel':rng.choice(['c2p','p2p','p2c'])})
ixps=[900001,900002]+list(range(910000,910000+1022))
queries=[]
for i in range(512):
    r=rng.random()
    if r<0.35:
        s=rng.randrange(NC); L=rng.randint(1,64)
        p=[((s+k)%NC)+1 for k in range(L)]
        if rng.random()<0.5 and L>2: p=p[:2]+[p[0]]+p[2:]   # loop
    elif r<0.7:
        s0=rng.randrange(0,40); p=CHAIN[s0:s0+rng.randint(1,24)]
    else:
        p=[rng.randint(1,130000) for _ in range(rng.randint(0,64))]
    if rng.random()<0.2: p=p+[rng.choice(ixps)]
    a=rng.randint(0,1000000); b=rng.randint(a,1000000)
    queries.append({'id':'q%03d'%i,'path':p[:64],'threshold':[a,b]})
data={'version':1,'ixps':ixps,'rib':rib,'priors':priors,'declared':declared,'order':order,'queries':queries}
raw=json.dumps(data).encode()
print("bytes",len(raw),"records",len(rib),"sumlen",sum(len(r['path']) for r in rib))
t0=time.perf_counter(); exp=ref.solve(json.loads(raw)); t1=time.perf_counter()
got=main.solve(json.loads(raw)); t2=time.perf_counter()
print("ref %.2fs main %.3fs"%(t1-t0,t2-t1))
def close(a,b,path=""):
    if type(a) is dict:
        if set(a)!=set(b): print("keys differ",path,set(a)^set(b)); return False
        return all(close(a[k],b[k],path+"/"+str(k)) for k in a)
    if type(a) is list:
        if type(b) is not list or len(a)!=len(b): print("len differ",path,len(a),len(b) if type(b) is list else type(b)); return False
        return all(close(x,y,path+"[%d]"%i) for i,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(a,b)))
    if type(a) is float:
        if type(b) not in (int,float): print("type differ",path,a,b); return False
        if abs(a-b)>1e-9*max(1,abs(a)): print("value differ",path,a,b); return False
        return True
    if type(a) is not type(b) or a!=b: print("differ",path,a,b); return False
    return True
ok=close(exp,got)
print("MATCH" if ok else "MISMATCH")
print("core links",sum(1 for l in got['links'] if l['round']==0),"total links",len(got['links']),
      "loop queries",sum(1 for q in got['queries'] if q['status']=='loop'))
